q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of a laminated tube?
title: Laminated tube carbon footprint per tube
short: Weigh the laminate web, shoulder and cap per tube and multiply by supplier figures. Add printing, tube forming, shoulder moulding and capping energy, then divide the plant's energy by tubes made.

ul: Aluminium barrier laminate or all-plastic laminate.

p: Report per tube by diameter, length and laminate type. An aluminium barrier laminate often carries more footprint than an all-plastic one.

example.title: Worked example: plant energy per tube (one month)
lines: Plant total: 35,500 / 3,000,000 = 0.0118 kg CO2 per tube
Add laminate, shoulder and cap for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
